Mechanical Engineering Programme students actively participated in the Career Guidance Program conducted by BARC, gaining insights into research careers, training opportunities, and the role of engineers in India’s nuclear and advanced technology sectors.
Mechanical Engineering Programme students explored the career pathways, understand industry expectations, and prepare for opportunities in research, innovation, and engineering excellence.

The session by BARC experts inspired Mechanical Engineering students with knowledge on scientific careers, higher studies, and skill development required for contributing to national research and technology missions.
